name: Golf Coaching Package ($6,000/year)
description: Professional golf coaching package sales script with Tiger Woods-level training

stages.name: Rapport
stages.title: Lay a foundation for roles and who I am
stages.objective: Learn about them, their wants, their fears, invite them to brag about successes and disclose fears (in a playful way)
keyPhrases: tell me about your golf game
detectionPhrases: my role here is to listen

mirroring.trigger: I am unhappy with my short game. I got a new putter but it didn't help.

proactiveValidation.trigger: I am tired of having the worst score with my friends.
proactiveValidation.response: I agree, and they won't shut up with the jokes at your expense, right?

calibratedQuestion.trigger: I tried a local coach but it didn't work out well.
calibratedQuestion.response: What was your budget for your coach?

transition.phrase: Is it OK if WE discuss 3 of the most common problems we help golfers overcome?

stages.name: Problem Intro
stages.title: Why are we talking?
stages.objective: Introduce common pain points in golf coaching, then focus on prospect's specific pain and problems

emotionalResponseValidation.trigger: I am tired of paying for no results. My coach is an idiot.
emotionalResponseValidation.response: Certainly isn't fair to pay for something you aren't getting.

stages.name: Solution Intro
stages.title: How can we make this better?
stages.objective: High-level overview of package as superior alternative, teasing benefits without diving deep
detectionPhrases: is it ok if we discuss

accusationAudit.response: At first you might think that 6 grand is a lot of money, but 68% of our customers feel it saves them time and money, and lots of frustration, over amateur coaches that take your money for no results.

calibratedQuestion.response: Last month a client of ours won $9k at $1,000 per hole bets against his buddies. Smiling ear to ear he said, 'best investment in myself I have ever made.' How difficult would it be for you to get away for 4 days next month to play and learn from a pro golf coach?

stages.name: Problem Application
stages.title: How does this problem apply to prospect (MEFS)?
stages.objective: Probe how the general problem impacts them personally across MEFS to build emotional connection
keyPhrases: let's talk about how this plays out for you
does inconsistent coaching leave you second-guessing

calibratedQuestion.response: 5 weeks ago a client said, 'If I knew how good it would feel to finally play this game I love at a higher level, I would have signed up years ago!' How would you feel to finally get the improvement to your short game that you deserve?

stages.name: Current Solution
stages.title: What is their solution if they don't work with us?
stages.objective: Explore their current approach to highlight gaps, using MEFS to quantify dissatisfaction
keyPhrases: what are you doing now for coaching
how does it fit into your life
detectionPhrases: local coach has cost you money

noMeansYes.response: It seems like your local coach has cost you money and given you grief. Your buddies are like mine, tormenting you when you give them reasons, so stop! And golf should be fun, not frustrating. So from what WE have discussed, is there anything about our program that would make you feel uncomfortable in packing your bags to golf with real pros in a few weeks?

stages.name: Our Difference
stages.title: How can we make a difference? MEFS (easier, faster, better, happier, $$)
stages.objective: Contrast package benefits against their current solution, emphasizing improvements in MEFS
keyPhrases: here's how we can make a real difference
better value than ongoing local fees

stages.name: Ideal Solution
stages.title: What would their ideal solution look like? (MEFS)
stages.objective: Let them describe their dream outcome to align visions and reveal desires
keyPhrases: how would it sharpen your game mindset

stages.name: Alignment Check
stages.title: Where are we NOT aligned?
stages.objective: Address any misalignments head-on to resolve objections and confirm fit
keyPhrases: maybe this isn't right for you

takeAway.response: John if it is not completely obvious that this is exactly what you have been looking for to finally improve your golf game and feel great every time you play, then don't do it!

followUp.response: John I am not going to let you do this unless you can convince me that you are excited about it, can afford it, and will enjoy golf more than ever have a year long pro instructor.

stages.name: Close
stages.title: Sale
stages.objective: Close naturally once alignment is achieved, confirming commitment

transitions.1to2: Is it OK if WE discuss 3 of the most common problems we help golfers overcome?
transitions.2to3: Is it OK if we discuss the 5 benefits WE give our members?
transitions.3to4: Let's talk about how this plays out for you.
transitions.4to5: What are you doing now for coaching?
transitions.5to6: Here's how we can make a real difference:
transitions.6to7: If you could design the perfect coaching solution, what would it include?
transitions.7to8: Based on what you've shared, where are we NOT aligned?
